brief:
Mondoweiss reported that Republican J.D. Vance attributed his party's midterm election losses partly to Israel, signaling shifting public opinion on the issue across the political spectrum. Vance's remarks suggest that the traditional role of the Israel lobby in controlling the narrative around Israel and Zionism has diminished, according to observers cited in the outlet.

The assessment reflects broader demographic changes and emerging political divisions over U.S. support for Israeli policies, marking a departure from decades of bipartisan consensus on the issue.
dek: “Everyone knows why we lost,” J.D. Vance said after the Republican wipeout in the midterm elections, and among the reasons he cited was Israel. For decades, the Israel lobby worked to keep Zionism’s bigotry off voters’ radar. Those days are over.
title: U.S. voters across parties reject Israel policy, Vance says
